query:
SELECT 
  COUNT(*) as total_active,
  SUM(CASE WHEN street IS NOT NULL AND street != '' AND street != 'NULL' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as has_real_street,
  SUM(CASE WHEN latitude IS NOT NULL AND latitude != 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as has_geocode,
  SUM(CASE WHEN (street IS NULL OR street = '' OR street = 'NULL') AND zip IS NOT NULL AND zip != '' AND zip != 'NULL' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as has_zip_no_street,
  SUM(CASE WHEN street IS NULL OR street = '' OR street = 'NULL' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as no_street
FROM pco_people WHERE status = 'active';
